notes.title: Holiday Cheer - Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays! Ace stopped by and decked your stand out for the holidays. He also found some weird type of tree that spawns hot dogs on it. If you're in a pinch, check the tree to see if there is anything that can help you out during a stressful shift!

Other Fixes
- Fixed an issue where in some cases, mouse sensitivity could be 0 for first time players
- Fixed an issue where the tutorial menu would not scale properly on all screens
- Improved the rotation of items when they are being held

Update 1.1

I've been hard at work on the first major update, 1.1. This update will bring an entirely new game mode, Chaos Mode, which will finally bring MULTIPLAYER to GTG! Imagine cooking hot dogs with a few of your closest friends. What a time! The other major focus will be full Steam Deck and Controller support. 

General timeline is January 2024. I will be sharing much more in the coming weeks.

As always, thank you for playing the game. If you haven't, please consider leaving a review on Steam!

notes.title: Future Plans + Patch Notes (Exploit killer)
notes.notes:
Glizzy Crusaders,

I hope you're all enjoying the game! If you've been having fun, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam, it helps a lot! Also, thank you for your patience while I get these bugs and issues stomped out. Okay, onto the patch notes.

Patch Notes

Exploits (get outta here!):

 Prevent all interactions when a phone call is active. You can no longer set up your stand before accepting phone calls in the beginning of shifts
 All toppings must be applied to food items while they are on a prep station (checkered paper thing). You can no longer put dogs inside of buns while they are still in in the warmer
 Your insta-warmed buns are safe...for now....


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a breaking bug if the pause menu was opened and the phone interacted with when an incoming call was active
 Fixed a bug where the veggie station would stay active even in a broken state
 Prevent the order bell from being clicked when an order has not been accepted on the POS. This will help your perfect game runs and prevent frustrating timing issues which would cause you to fail two orders almost instantly.
 Fixed an issue where some lingering customers would still order even though the shift has ended. Now they will go home hungry.


Gameplay changes:

 Ace will now only be active after Shift 1. Buying sabotages would do nothing if bought during shift one (sorry lol)
 Buttons at the bottom of the tablet (back to home screen, exit tablet) are now clickable. Keyboard interactions still work


Future Plans

I'm planning out a major content update which will bring an entirely new game mode. I won't say TOO much, but I will say I'm mulling over the idea of calling it 'Glizzy Survivors'. You can infer from that what you will. I'm hoping I can have it together in a few short weeks so stay tuned! Also with that, a new appliance type, more steam achievements and more. The game will forever be $4.99 btw. 

Thank you again for playing the game!
Typo

notes.title: Fixes and Balance Changes - v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello!

First of all, thank you again to everyone to has checked out the game! If you enjoy it, please consider leaving a positive review, it really helps!

Okay, now for the updates:

Sabotage Events are now directly tied to your competitor rating.  The higher their rating, the more sabotage events you will endure. Make sure you talk to Ace and keep them in check. Buying sabotage events reduces their rating, meaning you'll get hit less and you'll get more customers. 

- Reduced the cost of buying Sabotage Events
- Decreased the frequency of chaos events, frequency also now scales with combined competitor rating
- Fixed an issue with customers where they could bug out at the end of a shift
- Prevent the repair kit from being stuck in the prep counter. If it clips to an unreachable area, another will automatically respawn.
